summary: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates transit services on Aukland Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install temporary Traffic Control Signals at Aukland Road and Subway Crescent, in the vicinity of the Kipling Transit Station. Currently this intersection operates with all-way stop control. As work begins on the Metrolinx Kipling Bus Terminal Project, the westerly section of Subway Crescent will be closed and form part of the construction area (see Attachment 1). This will divert additional vehicular and pedestrian traffic along Aukland Road and the open portion of Subway Crescent. It is expected that the Metrolinx bus terminal project will take almost two years to complete. The proposed traffic control signals are required in order to facilitate safe pedestrian crossing to and from the Kipling Transit Station, minimize the impact to TTC bus transit service entering and exiting the station and improve ingress and egress to the commuter parking in the north lot and improve passenger pick-up/drop-off operations.
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the installation of temporary Traffic Control Signals at Aukland Road and Subway Crescent, to be in effect from April 24, 2018 to December 2019.
